scope_limited_admission.reason: The real frozen artifacts and the F35 semantic gate do not exist yet. Performance measurement remains forbidden unless that exact gate passes and the coordinator separately admits the controlled best-effort CPU window.

contracts_confirmed: The ordered matrix is exactly 56 cells with N64 seeds [0,1,7,7] repeated sixteen times, rotated worker order, separate Full and Summary, and separate Rust and PyO3 boundaries.

The frozen Plan is event-time-v2, stable-topological-serial, legacy-sequential-v1, unindexed, and bound by byte digest, fingerprint, duration, phases, source digest, lineage and exact execution artifacts.

The accepted legacy Python-reference float policy is isolated to that boundary. Legacy-to-O5, Full-to-Summary, worker-count and Rust-to-PyO3 decoded-tree comparisons are otherwise exact after only named normalization.
Serialized sample digests are used only for stability inside their producing backend. They are not cross-language semantic evidence.

Cell reports bind all fields exposed by each supported entrypoint. Rust does not fabricate a Plan SHA field absent from stage-c output; load and per-cell artifact checks bind its exact Plan bytes and command path.

The 1200-second unique window reserves a fixed 60-second cell cap and 10-second postflight budget, cannot resume, and retains partial evidence on timeout, invalid evidence or coordinator interruption.
SIGINT and SIGTERM handlers are installed before the formal clock, kill and reap only the owned child session/process group, retain partial state, and restore prior handlers.
PyO3 call_ns and whole-process RSS disclose warmup validation and proof cache history. Rust and PyO3 RSS are not treated as an incremental-memory ratio.
The CI workflow requires exactly 24 controls with zero skips or expected failures and does not run the F35 performance window.
